that wish better come true. or else.

yo, what's up bday boooooyyy


hope all your wishes come true, and that positivity ruins your life!

hahha, so, i was suggested to write you a poem.... but lord knows that'd be a complete disaster 

instead, I'll tell you some of my random thoughts and feelings about you, that I ABSOLUTELY wouldn't say if today wasn't such a goddamn special day


(BUUUTTT, its so long, you should be partying not reading)

(so, feel free not to read this at all!)



you know...

honestly, I've already said this one but watch me say it again

i really do like how you love fall, and your little detailed feelings about it. thanks to that, I see fall in a different light

I tend to overlook life, my peripheral view isn't as colourful as yours
some people dont even have that type of perspective, their on look of life is sorta superficial

so I'm sorry that I can't help but admire how you radiate 


if i ever see any bastard daring to belittle you, i might actually have to throw hands you'll have to hold my purse


so on that note, remember when when you randomly told me some people around you are, "better cut off "? you never really told me what happened, or what made you come to such a realisation
maybe bc you'd know I'd just swear and place a curse on them 


But either way, I'm glad you know you deserve to be treated well (Well enough to come to appreciate some bum like me)

I know that those around you, appreciate you like i do! Your ridiculous jokes could cheer anyone up, even the bluest of blue so I hope you never dare to doubt yourself

 however, I know how life can be so, if one day we ever drift apart, fight or even manage to hate each other

ill spare you

I could've just said, "I love you" instead of writing that whole paragraph

but you're too complex as a person for that, we need to appreciate every inch of you 



Once again, happy 20th birthday 

-dalal
